examples.q: How full is each warehouse relative to its capacity?
examples.gold: SELECT w.warehouse_name, w.capacity_units, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity_on_hand), 0) AS stock_held, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity_on_hand), 0) / NULLIF(w.capacity_units, 0), 2) AS utilisation_pct FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.capacity_units ORDER BY utilisation_pct DESC

base.sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, w.capacity_units AS capacity, (SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) * 100.0 / w.capacity_units) AS occupancy_percentage FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.capacity_units
